text:
marta: PRD intake: tenant burst mitigation + cost attribution. Problem statement: customers experience unpredictable QPS spikes (promo emails, product launches) that exhaust dedicated pools and drive both latency and bill shock. Need a bounded, low-risk fallback that keeps core SLAs and gives transparent cost signals to sales.

marta: constraints/non-goals: do NOT change pricing model in this project, do NOT rewrite the autoscaler core. Focus on routing/fallbacks + per-tenant controls + observability.

dina: high level goals: (1) automatic graceful fallback under sustained 2x bursts, (2) per-tenant cost showback, (3) operational runbook and rollback.

sam: measurable success metrics proposal:
- p99 latency for burst-handled requests <= 600ms (gateway-measured)
- request success rate >= 99.8% over 5m sustained 2x baseline bursts
- unit cost delta <= 25% over baseline during burst window (attributed per-tenant)
- quality: sampled automated eval pass rate >= 97% vs baseline on 500 prompts

leo: edge cases to capture: simultaneous multi-tenant spikes, sudden cache churn on prefix/KV, tenants abusing burst caps, region-specific capacity shortfalls. Also need to define what "baseline" is (30d rolling average QPS).

marta: proposed mitigation levers: (A) per-tenant burst budget + enforced caps, (B) soft-routing to cheaper model variants under pressure, (C) adaptive truncation of non-essential context, (D) temporary rate-shedding with prioritized queues.

sam: quick config sketch (not final):
```
burst_policy:
  enabled: true
  burst_budget_tokens_per_day: 50_000
  burst_window_minutes: 5
  fallback_model_map:
    - high: rwd-3b-q4
    - medium: rwd-1b-q4
    - low: rwd-small-q4
  truncation_strategy: last_n_tokens: 512
  abuse_threshold: 10x_baseline
```

dina: rollout & experiment plan suggestion:
1) feature flag gated (org-level opt-in)
2) Canary: 4 tenants (mix of small/med/large) for 72hrs, collect full metric set
3) 20% tenant rollout (rw) for 24hrs, compare to control group
4) GA if p99, success rate, and cost thresholds met for 48hrs

leo: monitoring/dashboard items to build: p50/p95/p99 latency, queue depth, per-tenant token usage, per-tenant cost attribution by model variant, degraded_response_rate, cache hit ratio, and alerts for abuse_threshold.

sales-anna: important: sales needs per-tenant cost breakdown by model variant and routing decision exported to billing reports (CSV) so we can justify charges and propose capacity upsell.

marta: acceptance criteria (draft):
- Functional: fallback triggers when dedicated pool saturation > 80% sustained for 30s or per-tenant burst budget exceeded
- Latency & availability: meet the metrics above (p99 <=600ms, success >=99.8% over burst window)
- Cost: observed unit cost increase <=25% and per-tenant attribution works end-to-end in billing export
- Quality: automated evals show >=97% pass on 500-sample set during canary
- Runbook: documented rollback steps and incident playbook in Console runbooks

sam: sampling details: 500 prompts drawn proportionally across tenant traffic, evaluate against baseline model using existing eval harness, window = burst duration + 10m post-burst. Need to include seed corpus and deterministic scoring.

leo: abuse mitigation: hard token caps, exponential backoff on repeated bursts, alerting to SEs and CSMs, and an automatic temporary hold if cost delta > 200% for a tenant in 1h.

marta: deliverables & owners:
- Draft PRD (problem/goals/non-goals/acceptance) -> marta + sam by Tue EOD
- Dashboards and alert definitions -> leo by Tue EOD
- Billing export hook & CSV schema -> sales-anna + infra by Wed
- Canary tenants & SE coord -> dina by Wed

prod-bot: PRD template: https://redwood.company/prd-template  Please attach PRD link here when ready.

marta: timeline ask: target RFC by next Friday if PRD greenlit. If anyone has regulatory/privacy flags (e.g., PII-sensitive tenants) call them out now so we can include in non-goals.

dina: one more ask  include cost attribution at token-level by model variant, plus an aggregated per-tenant monthly view for sales.

sam: noted. I'll add sampling logic for tests and the eval list.

leo: I'll prototype dashboard widgets and a mock CSV export for review.

marta: thanks all. If no objections I'll open the PRD doc and add owners. Ping me on-thread when you start edits. :thumbsup:
